mcqs.q: How many planetary boundaries did Rockstrom et al identify in 2009?
What is a climate tipping point?
options: A tipping point is when world leaders agree to act on climate change.
Tsunamis are caused by the moon's gravity at full moon.
A tipping point is just when warming reaches 1.5 degrees C.
A threshold beyond which a system changes irreversibly into a new state — e.g. the Amazon flipping from rainforest to savanna, or Greenland's ice sheet committing to total melt.
FDI is when individuals send money home to their families abroad.
Tsunamis are caused by the moon's gravity at full moon.
The sudden vertical displacement of a large volume of water, usually by an undersea earthquake, but also by underwater landslides or volcanic eruptions.
Tsunamis are caused by strong winds over the ocean.

Cross-border investment where a firm acquires lasting control or ownership of assets in another country (e.g. building a factory, buying a company) — distinct from short-term portfolio investment in shares.
FDI is when individuals send money home to their families abroad.
A tipping point is when world leaders agree to act on climate change.
FDI is the same as foreign aid given by governments.
